doc.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: I’m Bob Daughtry. We’re here with George Russell. Today is Wednesday, May 5th, 2004. This is for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Project. It’s tape 3. Kotea Stitt is engineering. George, how are you feeling today?
You look well. I’m wondering what your secret is.
I just live a long time.
You really are looking well today.
